headlines.title: Giant Pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang Arrive in Atlanta on the FedEx Panda Express
headlines.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn., September 27, 2026--FedEx Corporation transported two giant pandas, six-year-old male Ping Ping and five-year-old female Fu Shuang, from Chengdu, China to Atlanta, Ga.

headlines.title: What Does FedEx (FDX) New Authenticated Delivery Service Mean For High Value Shipments?
headlines.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) has introduced FedEx Authenticated Delivery, a new premium service focused on secure, digitally verified shipments. The product targets high-value deliveries for sectors such as luxury goods, healthcare, and other sensitive categories. FedEx Authenticated Delivery is designed to reduce fraud, theft, and misdelivery risk through tighter identity and delivery verification.

headlines.title: Carrier diversity key to holiday success in a high cost environment
headlines.summary: Even saving a few dollars per order on shipping fees can free up capital for other parts of a business, UniUni Chief Revenue Officer Sheila Berry said.

headlines.title: Raj Subramaniam, President and Chief Executive Officer of FedEx Corporation, Receives Appeal of Conscience Award at 61st Annual Gala in New York
headlines.summary: The Appeal of Conscience Foundation presented Raj Subramaniam, President and Chief Executive Officer of FedEx Corporation, with the Appeal of Conscience Award at the foundation's 61st Annual Gala, at The Pierre Hotel in New York City.

headlines.title: FreightWise Named to FreightWaves' 2027 FreightTech100
headlines.summary: FreightWise, a leading provider of managed transportation and Transportation Management System (TMS) technology, today announced it has been named to the 2027 FreightTech100 by FreightWaves. FreightWise, backed by its Kuebix TMS platform, is among 100 companies selected for their innovation across the freight and supply chain technology industry.

description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
